reason: I already pay for Calm and I'm used to it, and my AirPods already stop the sound when I doze off. I might try the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge, but I'm not adding a second sleep subscription on my pay.
objection: Paying for two sleep apps makes no sense for me, and I doubt a phone on the bed can really tell when I fell asleep after a night shift when I'm wiped out anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If the 14-day comparison clearly showed I fall asleep a lot faster after shifts than with Calm, I'd cancel Calm and switch, but only if it's cheaper than what I pay now.
